title: How much is in the cart already
description: Counting the items picked at the prices you know, and seeing separately the ones not counted yet.

blocks.text: Someone marks the items in the cart and enters the price they know. The screen shows the total of what has been taken and, separately, the items not yet counted. Changing a quantity or removing a purchase explains the change in the total straight away.

quote.text: It’s important that I know what my total will be at the end of shopping, and also see how much each item will be after taxes. This app does that for me.

blocks.text: Manual prices and a simple quantity are enough to start with. Products sold by weight need a visible estimate; discounts and extra charges are counted only on the terms entered, with no promise of matching the receipt exactly.
A number with limits you can see

It has to be tested whether entering prices right at the shelf is convenient. If it takes too many actions, the calculation stays a nice capability that people stop using before the trip is even over.
